summary: Implemented FastAPI CRUD router (GET/POST /api/todos, PATCH/DELETE /api/todos/{id}, and /stats) with filtering, aggregate metrics telemetry, deterministic timestamp updates, and real-time WebSocket change event broadcasting, wired into harness/server.py.

acceptance_criteria_verification.filtering_and_query_support: GET /api/todos supports query parameters 'status', 'priority', and 'q' (search matching title or description) with clean case-insensitive resolution.
acceptance_criteria_verification.aggregate_metrics_alongside_tasks: GET /api/todos returns TodoListResponse including both matching task items and complete TodoStats aggregate metrics (total counts, expected hours per status, MVP count/hours).
acceptance_criteria_verification.deterministic_patch_timestamp: PATCH /api/todos/{id} performs partial updates and strictly advances updated_at timestamp while preserving other attributes and returning HTTP 404 for missing resources.
acceptance_criteria_verification.realtime_websocket_broadcast: Emits TODO_CREATED, TODO_UPDATED, and TODO_DELETED events with full payload over the shared WebSocket bus for instant cross-agent synchronization.
